note: Copilot & AI #20. BILLED per token (not verified: read each model's price on the Azure pricing page before recording and put the real prices in config.json); Foundry resource in Sweden Central, 2 or 3 GlobalStandard deployments, Application Insights for tracing. The owner chooses the 2 or 3 deployable models and writes them to C:\MGLab\work\copilot-20\deployments.json and config.json (real deployment names and prices); prepare refuses to continue while config.json still has REPLACE- placeholders. Delete the resource group right after the take. A screen that needs a second capture of another kind lists it under 'then'.
prepare: if (-not (Test-Path C:\MGLab\work\copilot-20\config.json)) { Copy-Item src/samples/config.json, src/samples/tasks.json C:\MGLab\work\copilot-20\ }

if (Select-String -Path C:\MGLab\work\copilot-20\config.json -Pattern 'REPLACE-' -Quiet) { throw 'Edit C:\MGLab\work\copilot-20\config.json first: real deployment names and the real per-token prices (see demo.md Setup 6)' }

if (-not (Test-Path C:\MGLab\work\copilot-20\deployments.json)) { throw 'Write the 2 or 3 deployable models as C:\MGLab\work\copilot-20\deployments.json (array of name, format, model, version, sku, capacity; see src/infra/main.bicepparam)' }
# owner signs in (browser or device code) as labadmin
az group create --name rg-mglab-copilot-ai-20 --location swedencentral -o none

$o = az deployment group create --resource-group rg-mglab-copilot-ai-20 --template-file src/infra/main.bicep --parameters accountName=mglabfoundry20 deployments=@C:\MGLab\work\copilot-20\deployments.json --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json
$me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
az role assignment create --assignee-object-id $me --assignee-principal-type User --role 'Foundry User' --scope $o.projectResourceId.value -o none
# manual (owner): connect Application Insights to the project in the Foundry portal (Learn quickstart, Connect Application Insights for agent tracing) and make sure labadmin can read traces

# manual (owner): first run off camera as the safety take: python -m foundry_multimodel run --config config.json --tasks tasks.json --out safety.json (in the work folder); a model that fails because of the tool is a script bug to fix

screens.name: foundry-models
steps: Open the project created by src/infra/main.bicep
Open Models + endpoints (deployments) and show every deployment used in the run with the deployment name column visible
mask: resource and project names that contain the tenant name

screens.name: run-report
commands: python -m foundry_multimodel run --config config.json --tasks tasks.json --out results.json --keep-agents | ForEach-Object { $_ -replace '[\w-]+(\.services\.ai\.azure\.com)','<resource>$1' }
mask: resource name replaced in the output
results.json is never printed (it contains the resource name)
screens.note: Record the REAL results: plan line (models x tasks = requests), scorecard, routing lines, failed checks. If every model scores 1.00 the tasks were too easy: add a harder task before publishing. If a deployment errors show the setup-errors line.

screens.name: foundry-agents
steps: Same project, Agents page, while the agents of the --keep-agents run still exist
Show one agent per model named mglab-ep20-<model>, version 1
Open one agent and show its definition: the model deployment and the instructions
Then delete the agents (the teardown also removes the whole resource group)
mask: resource and project names that contain the tenant name

screens.name: foundry-trace
steps: Same project, Tracing (Application Insights connected beforehand)
Open one trace from the run and show the model call with input and output tokens and its duration
If tracing is not connected or shows nothing, drop the scene and its narration (never fake it)

teardown: # manual (owner): confirm in the portal that the resource group is gone; if the next deployment complains about the account name, az cognitiveservices account list-deleted and az cognitiveservices account purge for this one; remove the Foundry User role assignment if it was scoped outside the resource group
needs: paid:azure-foundry-model-tokens (read the price per model before recording)
